puzzles.name: The Transit Sequence

steps: Read the route code on the ticket.
Set the cabinet dial to the watch time 0217.
Enter the route code suffix 17 as confirmation.

puzzles.hint: The ticket tells you where; the watch tells you when.
puzzles.failure_feedback: The archive lock resets. No penalty.

puzzles.name: The Original Dispatch
puzzles.objective: Prove the contract target list was altered.

steps: Place the original dispatch sheet first.
Compare its target list with Marek's copy.
Place the handler amendment last to reveal the inserted name.

puzzles.failure_feedback: The documents return to the desk.

puzzles.name: The False Route
puzzles.objective: Choose the only safe path through Silas's map room.

steps: Reject the route marked with the same symbol as the decoy map.
Follow the patrol order in reverse because the recording is mirrored.
Take the route whose exit symbol matches the original ledger.
solution.answer: reverse patrol path to ledger-marked exit

puzzles.hint: The recording is mirrored, not the map.
puzzles.failure_feedback: A harmless trap resets the room.

puzzles.name: Proxy Clause
puzzles.objective: Identify the conditions required for a valid proxy.

steps: Select full disclosure as mandatory.
Select voluntary choice as mandatory.
Reject coercion and hidden information.
Confirm the proxy action must close the listed contract, not replace its targets.
solution.answer: full disclosure + free choice + original target conditions

puzzles.hint: Silas's notes explain the rule; they do not override it.
puzzles.failure_feedback: The archive asks you to review the rule index again.

puzzles.name: The Return Record
puzzles.objective: Send Dev a complete, verifiable case file.

steps: Attach the original contract.
Attach the amendment and dispatch sheet to prove fraud.
Attach the proxy clause so Dev understands the consequence.
Send the complete file through the one-way gate.
solution.answer: complete evidence bundle delivered before Dev's decision

puzzles.hint: A request without proof is not informed consent.
puzzles.failure_feedback: The message gate refuses incomplete evidence.

puzzles.name: The Night Reconstructed
puzzles.objective: Determine what happened to Arin and Dev.

steps: Place Arin's murder at 02:17 using the watch and route record.
Place Dev's evidence-room entry after the murder using the witness account.
Place the fire and Dev's death after his entry using the keycard and recording.
Reject the claim that Dev was only an unwilling witness; his confession states he chose to kill Arin.
solution.answer: Dev killed Arin, later tried to destroy the ledger, and died in the evidence-room fire

puzzles.hint: Separate the murder timeline from the later evidence-room fire.
puzzles.failure_feedback: The timeline board clears without losing collected clues.
